mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_market WHERE del_flag = '0' AND name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%') ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT m.* FROM app_market m INNER JOIN app_market_user u ON m.id = u.market_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%') ORDER BY m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_market (name, remark, create_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{remark}, #{createBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_market SET name=#{name}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_market SET del_flag='2' WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app_market_user WHERE market_id=#{marketId}

SELECT a.id, a.market_id as marketId, a.app_id as appId, a.env_id as envId, a.shared_by as sharedBy, a.create_time as createTime, u.nickname as sharedByName FROM app_market_app a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.shared_by = u.id WHERE a.market_id = #{marketId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_market_app (market_id, app_id, env_id, shared_by) VALUES (#{marketId}, #{appId}, #{envId}, #{sharedBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_market_app WHERE market_id=#{marketId} AND app_id=#{appId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_market_app WHERE market_id=#{marketId} AND app_id=#{appId}
SELECT m.* FROM app_market m INNER JOIN app_market_user u ON m.id = u.market_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_market_user WHERE market_id=#{marketId} AND user_id=#{userId}
